title: A ladder is not a toy
lines: Most falls from height happen from a ladder.
A ladder stands on a level surface, locked, and at the right angle.
Climb facing the ladder, with three points of contact at all times.
For long or heavy work? A basket or scaffolding is better.
In our training we practice this for real, not just in theory.
